name: Mighty Chimps
summary: You are a chimp and you move using your hands. This game includes different maps such as chill forest, a jungle cave, moon map, upside-down islands and volcano. It has cool cosmetics that you can use to customize your character and even use to fly around the map. There are many gamemodes like Sandbox, Glass bridge, Prophunt, Tag, Horror, PVP, Zombie defense and so much more!
